palette_contrast_contract.policy: Preserve or exceed the source Theme contrast throughout every protected region.

safe_zone_contract.profile_instruction: Create a content-page field with a calm readable center/content area and visibly richer but low-frequency peripheral material. Add the required asymmetrical 2B edge/corner treatment without creating a fake panel or object.
safe_zone_contract.2b_direction: 2B is required: use declared content-page edge/corner zones when present, otherwise use the profile-default outer-edge recipe; it must not enter text, card, chart, or connector regions.
semantic_safe_regions: content body and transition region need a quiet, readable, low-frequency field
free_design_regions: declared or profile-default edge and corner design zones
forbidden_regions: text, cards, charts, connectors, and semantic modules
safe_zone_contract.rationale: layout=cover-center-title-edge-decor is a content-led composition; use the content SAFE ZONE as a designed readable field

named_zones: outer top-left and bottom-right corners, 2-6% inset, using only unoccupied portions
the widest verified outer edge or corner free zone, moved away from any measured foreground halo

layout_prescribe.top_left: 大面積有機色塊，從左上鋪向中段，柔和邊緣。
layout_prescribe.top_right: 大型幾何線格圖樣（三角網格），佔右上角區。
layout_prescribe.right_edge: 右緣大型圓形色塊，約畫面三成高。
layout_prescribe.bottom_corners: 左下、右下各一組點陣（dot matrix）。
layout_prescribe.bottom_band: 底部滿寬細色帶，貼齊下緣。

required_visible_primitives: two cropped L-shaped corner brackets, each 6-12% of slide width with 1-2px strokes
one short hairline or 3-5 dot/dash cluster near an outer edge, clearly separate from 2A texture
prescribe.placement: Use asymmetrical outer-edge placement; if a corner is occupied, move that primitive to the farthest visible outer edge. Never enter text, cards, charts, connectors, or semantic modules.
prescribe.palette: theme accent or support-accent at visible opacity; abstract decoration, no text or recognizable object

layout_free_zone.rule: design_zone 內為 free geometric composition zone； opacity 白底 40–60% / 深色底 60–80%；色彩限制於 theme palette； 不得侵入 protected 安全區。

free_zone.fallback_rule: Use a broad low-frequency accent wash or wedge attached to one edge as 2A support, while keeping the two 2B primitives visibly readable on top of or beside it.

visibility.light_background: 15-22% opacity minimum; use the theme accent or support-accent
visibility.dark_background: 30-45% opacity minimum; use a clearly separated theme accent
visibility.normal_viewing_size: 2B must be distinguishable from the 2A material at normal slide size

2b_spec.acceptance: If the result reads as only paper, texture, or gradient with no visible brackets/edge marks, regenerate.

design_zone.coverage: 可設計區 = 整個版面扣掉 protected。本 layout 安全區小、可設計區大， 裝飾可佔據四周大面積負空間（非僅邊角）。
